LESSON: ORDERING CLASSIFICATION

Grade: PP1
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Ordering CLASSIFICATION

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Ordering CLASSIFICATION. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate vocabulary related or height. to ordering for effective • Learners in small groups/pairs, communication individually arrange objects

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: ORDERING CLASSIFICATION
Ordering CLASSIFICATION is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Ordering CLASSIFICATION problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Ordering CLASSIFICATION question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Ordering CLASSIFICATION question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Ordering CLASSIFICATION set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Ordering CLASSIFICATION.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Ordering CLASSIFICATION in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate vocabulary related or height. to ordering for effective • Learners in small groups/pairs, communication individually arrange objects

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
